title.text: Determinism: the same program always gives the same result

phrase.text: With the same program, the same inputs and the same seed, the engine always produces the same output, on any computer.

blocks.title: Three dice rolls

runs.text: A seed is like the way a deck of cards is shuffled: if two people shuffle exactly the same way, they draw the same cards. The analogy stops working in that the engine shuffles nothing; it computes each number from the previous one.

points.text: Same program, same inputs and same seed: same result.
Randomness comes from a seeded source.
Tasks, clock, files and network are controlled so as not to break determinism.
